verdict.rationale: Superset lets a developer describe a feature in a prompt, launch a CLI coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, etc.) in an isolated workspace, and review/commit/PR the agent's changes end-to-end (superset-docs-18, superset-docs-4, superset-docs-5, superset-docs-17). However, Superset itself is an orchestration/workspace layer, not the agent doing the implementation — actual feature completion and test-writing quality depend entirely on the underlying agent, and no evidence explicitly confirms tests are written or verified as part of the workflow. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of test-writing/verification as part of a task, and independent hands-on confirmation that end-to-end feature delivery (not just diffs/PRs) succeeds.
